name: Yabuki Shingo
source:
Country: Japan.
An excitable young man who looks up to Kyo and idolizes him. Decidedly a good boy, despite his various eccentricities. He learned how to fight watching his idol do it whether in real time or taped. He dreams of manipulating fire. While knowing it is impossible, he is a hard worker who wants to make it come true. A goofy comic relief character who has a lot of heart. He sees everyone as a friend.
